source.title: AI-generated posters don’t have to be horrible
source.author: ereiamjh

title.zh: AI海报设计：摆脱千篇一律
title.en: AI Poster Design Beyond the Generic Look

excerpt.zh: AI海报设计不必陷入柔和、手作风模板；通过明确的视觉风格、版式和色彩要求，活动海报可以更有辨识度。
excerpt.en: AI poster design can move beyond repetitive pastel templates by specifying a clear visual style, layout, and colour direction.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: AI海报设计的问题不只是“难看”
text.en: The AI Poster Design Problem Is More Than Ugliness

text.zh: AI海报设计常被批评为千篇一律：柔和配色、手绘花饰、飘带和“手作市集”式构图反复出现。原文作者认为，真正令人厌烦的并非每张海报都很糟，而是相同视觉套路被看过太多次，最终让地方活动失去辨识度。
text.en: AI poster design is often criticised for looking interchangeable: soft colours, hand-drawn florals, bunting, and familiar craft-fair layouts appear again and again. The author argues that the deeper problem is repetition. Individual posters may be acceptable, but the same visual formula quickly makes local events feel indistinguishable.

text.zh: 用具体风格提示改变AI海报设计
text.en: Specific Style Prompts Can Change AI Poster Design

text.zh: 作者用一场虚构的春季市集测试ChatGPT，先得到一个典型的节庆海报，再要求完全不同的设计美学。Bauhaus影响的几何现代主义版本更具层次和冲击力。随后，作者让模型尝试瑞士风格、孔版印刷、剪纸拼贴、粗野主义、日本极简、孟菲斯设计、复古朋克同人志和90年代鼓打贝斯传单等方向。
text.en: Using invented details for a spring fair, the author first asked ChatGPT for a poster and received a familiar event design. A second request for a completely different aesthetic produced a more distinctive, Bauhaus-influenced geometric poster. Further prompts explored Swiss Style, risograph printing, cut-paper collage, softened brutalism, Japanese minimalism, Memphis design, punk zines, and 1990s drum-and-bass flyers.

text.zh: 这组尝试说明，先描述目标风格，再要求模型生成该风格中的海报，往往比笼统地说“做一张漂亮海报”更有效。若不熟悉设计术语，也可以让模型提供风格菜单，再根据示例选择。这样的流程不是为了隐藏AI参与，而是为了避免默认模板主导结果。
text.en: The experiments suggest that asking for a poster within a named or clearly described design tradition is more effective than simply requesting something attractive. People who do not know the terminology can ask the model for a menu of styles and choose from the examples. The goal is not to disguise AI involvement, but to prevent its default template from controlling the result.

text.zh: AI海报设计仍有明显限制
text.en: AI Poster Design Still Has Important Limits

text.zh: 作者承认，敏锐的观察者仍可能看出这些作品是AI生成的；风格变化并不等于彻底摆脱机器感。连续修改还可能让额外文案进入上下文，并在后续海报中被模型沿用，造成不必要的文字漂移。因此，最好从一开始就明确风格、内容和排版要求。
text.en: The author acknowledges that attentive viewers may still recognise the posters as AI-generated; stylistic variety does not eliminate the machine-made feel. Iterative prompting can also introduce extra copy into the conversation, which the model may reuse in later versions. Defining the style, content, and layout at the outset can reduce that drift.

text.zh: 另一个开放问题是可编辑性。原文提到，Claude和Gemini可以生成包含真实文字和图层的HTML、PNG或PDF工作流，但这部分并未展开验证。对实际活动而言，能否修改字体、文字和版面，可能和初始视觉效果同样重要。AI可以扩大创意选择，却不能替代最终的设计判断与校对。
text.en: Editability is another unresolved issue. The article notes that Claude and Gemini can support workflows involving HTML, PNG, or PDF with real text and layers, but it does not examine those capabilities in detail. For a real event, the ability to change fonts, copy, and layout may matter as much as the first visual result. AI can broaden the choice of directions, but final design judgement and proofreading remain necessary.
